extras: Requires Git installed on the host machine and is desktop-only.
intentEvidence: Version control for your vault, with an intuitive interface and no terminal required.
problem: Users need a way to track, review, and manage version control history (commits, changes, backups) of their vault without relying solely on command-line Git operations.
summary: Git History provides an intuitive UI for managing Git repositories within Obsidian, offering a visual timeline, source control panel, and diff viewer without needing the terminal.
